data.topic: Dimensional reduction for anyons in the average-field approximation
data.speaker: 杨绮云
data.speakerBio: 杨绮云现为西班牙毕尔巴鄂巴斯克应用数学中心(Basque Center for Applied Mathematics, BCAM)博士后研究员,博士毕业于法国里昂高等师范学校(École normale supérieure de Lyon)。其主要研究方向为与任意子(anyons)相关的偏微分方程问题,涵盖多体量子系统、Chern–Simons–Schrödinger方程以及不同数学模型之间的联系;同时研究费米子系统,涉及Hartree–Fock方程、Lipkin模型等。目前已在Annales Henri Poincaré等国际学术期刊发表论文三篇。
data.abstract: We study Abelian anyons at the mean-field/almost-bosonic level, whose dynamics are governed by the Chern–Simons–Schrödinger system. We consider the dimensional reduction of this 2D model by introducing an anisotropic trapping potential and derive an effective 1D model after tracing out the tightly confined direction, whose dynamics are described by a quintic defocusing nonlinear Schrödinger equation. We rigorously establish this reduction for ground-state energies and time-dependent solutions, under a uniform H^2 well-posedness assumption. This provides a natural way to understand how the statistical structure of a 2D anyon system is reflected in its 1D effective description.

data.topic: 预测人口的空间分布——跨越10年的Zipf’s Law研究
data.location: 大学城校园文二栋536国际学术报告厅
data.speaker: 陆铭
data.speakerBio:
陆铭，上海交通大学安泰经济管理学院讲席教授、教育部国家级人才称号获得者、中国发展研究院执行院长、中国城市治理研究院研究员、上海国际金融与经济研究院研究员。担任民建上海市委副主委和第十四届全国政协委员。
曾工作于复旦大学，曾作为富布莱特学者工作于美国哈佛大学和国家经济研究局
（NBER）。曾担任世界银行和亚洲开发银行咨询专家。著有专著《大国治理》和
《空间的力量》等，以及学术科普著作《大国大城》、《向心城市》。研究领域为中国经济、城乡和区域经济发展、劳动经济学。近年来的研究主要是对城市和区域发展政策进行评估，并为城市可持续发展，促进国内市场一体化和经济持续增长提供来自空间政治经济学的战略思考。
data.abstract:
提要：预测未来人口空间分布有利于有效配置公共资源，且有助于商业
选址。在过去10 余年的时间里，我们用多种方法去预测了中国人口空间分布，
其中齐夫法则是非常重要的研究基础。近来的研究中，我们利用全球多个国家和
地区的数据考察了经济发展、市场一体化和齐夫法则之间的关系。并且在结构式
模型中模拟了当劳动成本力下降对人口空间分布的影响。这些研究共同指向一个
结论，随着时间推移和劳动力市场一体化水平的提高，齐夫法则将接近完美呈现。

data.topic: 中国科创债券的发行定价之谜——基于债券市场"科技板"的证据
data.location: 大学城校园文二栋301会议室
data.speaker: 张凯亮
data.speakerBio: 张凯亮,会计学博士,暨南大学管理学院会计系讲师。博士毕业于复旦大学管理学院,耶鲁大学管理学院海外联合培养。主要研究领域是债务契约、债券市场、银行信贷与公司财务,相关论文发表于《管理世界》。主持首批国家自然科学基金青年学生基础研究项目(博士研究生)和国家自然科学基金青年科学基金项目(C类)。
data.abstract: 债券市场"科技板"是我国构建科技金融体制的关键举措,有助于债券市场服务国家创新驱动发展战略和产业转型升级。全球范围内,科技创新活动具有高风险与高不确定性,而我国科技创新债券(科创债券)的发行定价却呈现出"高风险"与"低利率"并存的独特现象。对此,本文探究了我国科创债券的发行定价机理与经济后果。研究发现,相较于非科创债券,科创债券具有显著更低的发行利差,并且这一现象主要集中在交易所债券市场,而非银行间债券市场。机制分析表明,交易所债券市场中活跃的科创债券做市和科创债券ETF交易制度有效提高了科创债券流动性,降低了科创债券流动性溢价,从而降低了科创债券发行利差。异质性分析表明,当债券发行人科创属性更强、地区科创水平更高及发行人信用风险更低时,科创债券流动性效应更加显著。经济后果检验发现,公司发行科创债券后,其研发投入水平显著提升,表明科创债券能够有效支持公司科技创新活动。本文从创新型交易制度设计视角为我国科创债券发行定价之谜提供了理论解释,揭示了市场流动性供给机制在科创债券定价中的关键作用,为我国进一步推动科技金融战略提供了重要的政策启示。

data.speaker: 吕志
data.speakerBio: 吕志,复旦大学数学科学学院教授,博士生导师。主要从事代数拓扑、变换群以及环面拓扑研究,在等变协边分类及不变量、广义Smith 猜想、Kosniowski 猜想的研究上取得重要研究成果,发表在Math. Ann., Trans AMS, IMRN, Math. Z., AGT,Math. Res. Lett.等期刊上。多次主持国家自然科学基金及教育部博士学科点基金项目等。曾获教育部自然科学奖二等奖(独立)。
data.abstract: Classical equivariant bordism theories require computing the full collection of equivariant characteristic numbers to detect whether an equivariant manifold bounds equivariantly or not. In this talk, we consider simplified equivariant bordism characterizations for two families of equivariant manifolds with isolated fixed points: unitary T^k-manifolds and closed smooth (Z2)^k-manifolds. For a unitary T^k-manifold M with isolated fixed points, we establish an equivariant unitary bordism criterion built entirely from a single polynomial of equivariant Chern classes.

data.abstract: Understanding the transition mechanism of boundary layer flows is of great significance in physics and engineering, especially due to the current development of supersonic and hypersonic aircraft. In this talk, we introduce multiple unstable acoustic modes, which play a crucial role during the early stage of transition in the supersonic boundary layer. We also consider the subsonic inviscid spectral instability of the two-dimensional non-isentropic compressible Euler equations in a half-plane, with a particular focus on the instability mechanism driven purely by temperature variations.

data.speaker: 王佛泓
data.speakerBio: 王佛泓, 2022年本科毕业于中山大学物理学院,现为上海交通大学物理与天文学院凝聚态物理专业博士研究生(导师:许霄琰副教授)。主要从事量子多体物理、行列式量子蒙特卡洛算法、混态量子纠缠以及强关联费米子量子临界性等方面的研究。在 PNAS 、 Nature Communications 、 Physical Review Letters 等期刊发表4篇论文。
data.abstract: 强关联费米子体系中的多体量子纠缠与量子临界性是凝聚态物理的重要前沿问题。本报告围绕行列式量子蒙特卡洛( DQMC )方法的发展与应用,介绍我们在费米子混态纠缠度量及 Dirac 费米子量子相变方面的近期进展。在混态量子纠缠方面,我们利用费米部分转置的保高斯性质,发展了在 DQMC 中无偏计算相互作用费米子 R é nyi negativity 的方法;通过对比费米部分转置的"扭曲( twisted )"与"非扭曲( untwisted )"定义在量子 - 经典交叉与有限温相变中的标度行为,揭示了 untwisted 定义的反常非单调性,表明 twisted R é nyi negativity ratio 更适合作为费米子混态纠缠的可靠代理指标。在 Dirac 费米子量子临界性方面,针对蜂窝晶格半填充 Hubbard 模型中长期存在争议的 Gross-Neveu-Heisenberg 相变,我们发展了零温投影 DQMC 的子矩阵延迟更新( Submatrix-T )算法,将模拟规模推进至上万格点( L = 72 , N = 10,368 ),并结合系统的有限尺寸标度分析厘清了不同临界指数的收敛规律,更新了该普适类的临界指数。

data.location: 大学城校园文2栋301会议室
data.speaker: 李馨
data.speakerBio: 李馨,暨南大学管理学博士,华南师范大学经济与管理学院青年英才、特聘副研究员。主要研究领域为职场人机协同、领导力和能动性。研究成果发表在Journal of Organizational Behavior、Journal of Occupational and Organizational Psychology、International Journal of Contemporary Hospitality Management及《心理学报》《心理科学进展》等国内外权威学术期刊,相关成果被人大复印报刊资料全文转载。
data.abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly embedded in managerial work, making AI-related gender stereotypes more salient. These stereotypes are generalized social beliefs that portray men as more capable of, better suited to, and more legitimate in engaging with AI-related tasks or leadership roles, thereby shaping female leaders' career-relevant experiences and responses. Drawing on Social Cognitive Career Theory, this research examines how female leaders interpret and respond to AI-related gender stereotypes. Across three studies using an implicit association test (Study 1), an experiment (Study 2), and a multi-wave survey (Study 3), we find that AI-related gender stereotypes heighten female leaders' anticipated career barriers facing women employees, which in turn motivates adaptive leadership responses, including AI-supportive and collaboration-facilitating leadership behaviors. Moreover, a gender equality climate weakens the extent to which stereotypes translate into anticipated barriers. By centering on female leaders and focusing on career-relevant consequences of AI-related gender stereotypes, this study advances understanding of how gendered beliefs surrounding AI shape leadership experiences and responses in AI-intensive organizations.

Using spectral analysis and finite-dimensional reduction, we establish a global radial stability estimate for a conic Adams–Onofri inequality, with an optimal quadratic remainder. We also construct metrics for small curvature perturbations supported away from the singularities, preserving both cone orders and total curvature, and give conditions for local uniqueness.

data.speaker: 邓圣兵
data.speakerBio: 邓圣兵,西南大学数学与统计学院教授、博士生导师。2013年于智利大学获博士学位,2014年8月入职西南大学数学与统计学院。2014年入选重庆市高层次人才"第四类人才",2019年获重庆市自然科学基金杰出青年基金,2024年入选重庆市学术技术带头人。兼任欧美同学会拉美分会副会长、重庆市科技青年联合会第七届理事会理事等。主要从事非线性泛函分析、偏微分方程及其应用的研究,相关成果发表于《Science China Mathematics》《Proceedings of the London Mathematical Society》《Journal of Functional Analysis》《Journal of Differential Equations》等国际期刊。先后主持国家自然科学基金项目3项、省部级项目3项、重庆市高等教育教学改革研究项目2项。重庆市一流本科课程《泛函分析》负责人,重庆市本科高校课程思政教学名师和团队负责人。
data.abstract: We discuss nondegeneracy, stability and concentration for exponential biharmonic Choquard equations in dimension four. We first establish bubble nondegeneracy and global quantitative stability for the associated Adams-Choquard inequality. Using Lyapunov- Schmidt reduction, we then construct multi-bubble solutions in bounded domains. At nondegenerate critical configurations of the interaction function, we also obtain local uniqueness, nondegeneracy and the Morse index. Finally, we briefly discuss compactness and degree results for low-energy solutions on the sphere.

data.title: Yue Zhao——Gravitational wave probes to new physics beyond the Standard Model
data.topic: Gravitational wave probes to new physics beyond the Standard Model
data.speaker: Yue Zhao
data.speakerAffiliation: Hong Kong University of Science and Technology
data.speakerBio: Yue Zhao is a theoretical particle physicist who focuses on searching for new physics and understanding dark matter. He got his B.S. from Peking University and Ph.D. from Rutgers University. He did his postdoc at Stanford and U. of Michigan. He joined the Physics & Astronomy Department at the University of Utah in 2018, and he moved to Hong Kong University Science and Technology in 2025. Now he is the Associate Director of IAS Center for Fundamental Physics.
data.abstract: This talk will explore how gravitational-wave interferometers can serve as powerful probes of new physics across vastly different mass scales. I will first show that data from the LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA Collaboration can help resolve a long-standing puzzle: whether the GeV gamma-ray excess at the Galactic Center originates from annihilating weakly interacting massive particles or from a population of milisecond pulsars. Turning to lighter dark matter candidates, I will then demonstrate how the same gravitational-wave detectors enable the direct detection of several species of ultralight bosons, including dark photons, axions, and dilatons. Finally, I will present recent efforts to bring dark radiation into the scope of multi-messenger astronomy. More explicitly, we demonstrate how to fully utilize information from gravitational-wave channel physics to search for dark radiation from black hole mergers using quantum sensing techniques. Together, these methods illustrate how GW channels can form powerful discovery tools for new physics.

data.location: 大学城校园文二栋536国际学术报告厅
data.speaker: 余明珠
data.speakerBio: 余明珠,深圳大学管理学院教授、博士生导师,广东省青年珠江学者,深圳市 " 孔雀计划 " 海外高层次人才,深圳大学优秀学者,中国运筹学会随机服务与运作管理分会理事,中国系统工程学会物流系统工程专委会委员。于华中科技大学控制科学与工程系获得学士学位,于香港科技大学工业工程与物流管理系获得博士学位。主要从事物流与供应链管理、交通运输管理、 港口与航运领域的优化与博弈研究。发表 SCI/SSCI/EI/CSCD 收录论文50余篇,其中 ABS 4星期刊论文3篇, ABS 3星期刊论文9篇,有40余篇发表在 Transportation Research Part B , Naval Research Logistics , IISE Transactions , European Journal of Operational Research , Transportation Research Part E , International Journal of Production Research 以及 《中国管理科学 》《 系统工程理论与实践》等国内外权威期刊 。主持国家自然科学基金4项,广东省自然科学基金1项。获2022 INFORMS Conference on Service Science 最佳论文奖(唯一第一)、中国物流学会优秀论文一等奖、教育部高等学校电子商务类优秀课程思政课、广东省本科高校课程思政优秀案例一等奖、广东省一流本科课程等荣誉。
data.abstract: In maritime transportation, ocean liners have been adopting the demurrage and detention (D&D) charge, including a period of free time and an overtime fee, to ensure the smoothness of container circulation in the hinterland. In recent years, the D&D charge has been kept raising, which causes a question whether a high D&D charge really improves the return rate of the empty container in the hinterland. To address this issue, we propose a generic model for hinterland empty container repositioning considering D&D charge, with a solution method by a parallel column generation algorithm. We then introduce a concept of Efficiency Improvement Cost Difference (EICD), which reflects the incremental transportation cost required for the hinterland container operator (HCO) to move from the cost-oriented solution to the efficiency-oriented solution. Comprehensive sensitivity analyses are conducted to evaluate the effectiveness of the EICD-based charging strategy. The results indicate that the EICD-based charging strategy provides a win-win solution for both ocean liners and HCOs. For HCOs, the EICD strategy effectively encourages the multimodal transportation routes, thereby reducing their total repositioning cost; for ocean liners, it increases the empty container return rate. Sensitivity analysis demonstrates that extending the free time makes the HCOs incur more transportation cost for repositioning and achieve higher container return rate, which enhances the container return service quality.

data.speakerBio:
Pedro L. Rodríguez 是西班牙国家研究委员会（CSIC）研究教授，任职于 CSIC 和瓦伦西亚理工大学植物分子与细胞生物学研究所（IBMCP, CSIC-UPV）。他 1994 年获马德里自治大学分子生物学博士学位，随后在苏黎世联邦理工学院—慕尼黑工业大学 Erwin Grill 实验室从事脱落酶（ABA）信号传导博士后研究，1998 年加入瓦伦西亚理工大学研究植物非生物胁迫响应。其研究聚焦植物 ABA 信号分子机制，包括 PYR/PYL/RCAR 受体、2C 型蛋白磷酸酶和激酶在干旱响应中的作用，并开发基于 ABA 受体激动剂的生物技术工具以提升作物耐旱性。入选科睿唯安“高被引研究者”，Scopus 收录论文 166 篇，h 指数 72。近期，其团队与 Armando Albert (IQF-CSIC) 合作设计并表征新型 ABA 受体激动剂 iCB，可广谱激活 ABA 受体，在作物中减少水分散失、保护光合作用并提高水分利用效率。

Pedro L. Rodriguez is a Research Professor at the Spanish National Research Council (CSIC), affiliated with the Institute of Plant Molecular and Cellular Biology (IBMCP, CSIC-UPV), a joint institute of CSIC and Universitat Politecnica de Valencia. He received a Ph.D in Molecular Biology from Universidad Autonoma de Madrid in 1994, then conducted postdoctoral research on abscisic acid (ABA) signaling in Erwin Grill's laboratory at ETH Zurich-TU Munich, and in 1998 joined Universitat Politecnica de Valencia to study plant abiotic stress responses. His research focuses on the molecular mechanisms of plant ABA signaling including the roles of PYR/PYL/RCAR receptors, clade A PP2C phosphatases, and kinases in drought tolerance, and on developing biotechnological tools based on ABA receptor agonists to enhance crop drought tolerance. He was named a Clarivate Highly Cited Researcher; his Scopus record includes 166 papers and an h-index of 72. data.abstract: Recovery and forecast of network trafficdata from incomplete observed data is an important issue in internet engineering and management. In this talk, by fully considering the temporal stability and periodicity features in internet ra ffi cdata, a novel optimization model for internet data recovery and forecast is proposed, which is based upon the newly introduced higher-order tensor decomposition form called tubal tensor train (TTT) decomposition. Moreover, by introducing auxiliary variables and penalty techniques, a relaxation of the proposed model is obtained. Then, an easy-to-operate and effective algorithm for solving the relaxation model is proposed. We prove that the sequence generated by the proposed algorithm converges to a stationary point of the established relaxation model. A series of numerical experiments about the recovery of structurally missing tra ffi cdata and the tra ffi cdata prediction on the widely used real-world datasets demonstrate that our approach have favorable performance than some state-of-the-art tensor/matrix based approaches.

data.speaker: 曾长淦
data.speakerBio: 曾长淦,中国科学技术大学讲席教授、国家级领军人才。长期深耕于低维凝聚态物理与电学量子计量领域。近年来致力于发展暗腔增强真空涨落、层间拖拽、人工晶格势场等新型物态调控方法,揭示了一系列新奇电子态与量子输运效应。
data.abstract: 真空涨落可以诱发一系列独特的量子效应,包括自发辐射、兰姆位移以及卡西米尔效应。本次报告将介绍我们在凝聚态体系真空涨落物理方向的研究进展。我们成功研制了扫描卡西米尔力显微镜,并依托该装置在磁流体中实现了磁场调控卡西米尔力由吸引到排斥的可逆转变。另一方面,自由空间中的真空涨落通常十分微弱,难以对宏观凝聚态物质产生可观测效应;我们通过构筑暗腔增强量子涨落,进而实现了 NbSe 2 超导电性的增强。上述结果表明,真空不再仅仅是被动背景,而可成为调控物态的一种全新量子资源。

data.topic: The Tilted Scale: Local Protectionism in China's Intellectual Property Adjudication
data.speaker: 陈思含
data.speakerBio: 陈思含,中山大学经济学博士,华南师范大学经济与管理学院青年英才、特聘研究员。主要研究领域为区域经济学、中观经济学。研究成果发表于《经济研究》《经济学(季刊)》、Public Choice等国内外权威学术期刊。
data.abstract: This paper examines how politicians' social ties distort judicial decisions and affect innovation. Using intellectual property cases in China from 2014 to 2021, we show that when prefecture-level PLAC secretaries have hometown ties to their jurisdiction, local defendants are more likely to prevail against non-local plaintiffs, indicating judicial local protectionism. The effect arises only when local and non-local interests conflict and is stronger in cases with greater judicial discretion. An instrumental-variable strategy provides causal evidence. We further find that such protectionism reduces local innovation and weakens inter-regional knowledge flows, suggesting that political interference in adjudication hinders long-run technological progress.

data.topic: 精确希格斯物理
data.speaker: 王健
data.speakerBio: 王健, 2013年在北京大学获得博士学位,之后去德国做博士后, 2019年回国,任山东大学物理学院教授,主要研究领域是微扰量子色动力学 (QCD) 和对撞机物理。近几年,精确计算了强子对撞机上一对希格斯粒子产生过程的 QCD 次次次领头阶贡献和电弱次领头阶修正,得到了标准模型中顶夸克和希格斯粒子衰变宽度的 QCD 次次次领头阶解析结果,系统发展了在软共线有效理论框架下进行次领头幂次阶大对数重求和的方法。多篇论文被粒子物理领域综述 《Review of particle physics》 收录,多项研究成果被LHC实验组分析数据时采用。
data.abstract: 希格斯粒子是标准模型中非常独特的一种粒子,它的发现标志着标准模型的巨大成功。目前希格斯粒子与其他标准模型粒子的耦合系数已经测量得比较精准了。但是,与电弱对称自发破缺机制紧密相关的希格斯粒子的自耦合系数还有很大误差,目前实验上限可以达到标准模型预言值的六倍。我们研究了 LHC 上一对希格斯粒子产生截面的高阶电弱修正,得到了更准确的截面对自耦合系数的函数依赖关系,从而使得该上限大大降低。

data.abstract: We introduce a portfolio framework that jointly integrates investors' aversion to downside risk and distributional ambiguity. We measure downside risk with the lower partial moment and capture ambiguity with a distributionally robust formulation using a Wasserstein ball around a reference distribution of asset returns. Our problem is general and allows for various downside risk measures, orders of the Wasserstein distance, and choices of the cost function. We provide a convex dual formulation of the distributionally robust problem and characterize the Slater condition analytically. When the cost function is the Mahalanobis distance and the reference distribution is elliptical, we derive an analytical solution for the optimal portfolio and show that it is located on the sample mean-variance efficient frontier. For other cost functions, the optimal portfolio can be located outside of the frontier. We also establish formal relations between our framework and two classical portfolio paradigms showing that the risk-aversion and ambiguity-aversion coefficients can be linked to a more intuitive downside return threshold. An empirical analysis on datasets of characteristic-sorted portfolios and individual stocks shows that our portfolio strategies deliver gains in terms of downside risk, risk-return tradeoff, and turnover relative to distributionally robust mean-variance strategies, non-robust strategies, and naive diversification.

data.abstract: 数智融合是推动教育高质量发展与教育数字化转型的重要路径,在智慧教学、学术服务、教育治理等领域具备广阔应用前景。本报告首先梳理数智赋能教育的发展背景与典型范式,重点围绕 SCHOLAT 平台的建设定位,介绍面向教研、学术交流场景的数智化支撑体系,阐述平台基座对于打通学术资源、教研活动、学者协作链路的支撑价值。 报告进一步围绕数智技术赋能教学实践、学术服务等方向展开介绍梳理数智技术在教育场景下的典型应用模式,探讨知识图谱、智能检索等技术融入教育学术场景的可行方案,探索面向教育学术场景的智能服务构建思路。 最后结合 SCHOLAT 的实践探索,总结数智融合赋能教育发展的经验与现存瓶颈,展望人工智能、学术平台生态持续助力教育创新、学术提质的未来发展方向。

data.abstract: 同样面对开放窗口,什么因素决定了后发国家能否将外部技术与资本流入转化为本土近代工商业的实际创立？本文利用晚清中国的特殊历史情境——对外开放由条约体系外生强制(通商口岸)、地方自治由内部军事与财政演化形成(湘淮系督抚的崛起)——识别对外开放与地方分权的交互效应。湘淮系督抚凭借幕府人事网络、厘金财源和职位继承网络在东南各省建立事实上的地方自治,形成类似剩余索取权的财政激励。基于1865—1911年胡焕庸线以东276个城市的面板数据,匹配近代企业、官员任职与口岸开放记录,采用三重差分方法(DDD)研究发现:湘淮系治理与通商口岸的交互项显著为正,而两者各自的一次项均不显著,表明开放与分权存在互补效应,只有二者在空间上重合才构成近代工商业兴起的充分条件;该效应在督抚卸任后持续存在且随累计任职年数增强,说明其内嵌于治理结构而非官员个人能力;效应主要体现在商办企业而非官办企业,支持"为民间资本提供经营条件"假说;商办企业增加显著提升各省厘金收入,验证了财政激励逻辑。研究表明,非正式地方自治在提供保护市场的财政激励上可部分替代缺失的正式分权制度,"保护型开放的财政分权"对后发大国的经济现代化具有重要意义。

data.speakerBio: Elena Aladova Chestakov 是巴西圣保罗大学的博士后。她于2004年在莫斯科国立师范大学获得代数博士学位,并于2019年在巴伊兰大学获得计算机科学博士学位。她的主要研究领域是簇与多项式恒等式理论。目前,她主要从事泛代数几何方向的研究。
data.abstract: The superalgebras appeared first in algebraic topology and homology theory as a Z_2-graded algebra. The term "superalgebra" was introduced in theoretical physics. It served as an algerbaic apparatus for formulating "supersymmetry". In algebra, superalgebras were initially used as a tool for solving various problems. However, at some point, interest in studying superalgebras as purely algebraic structures grew. In this talk we give a definition of a superalgebra and consider various examples. Next, we will focus on the questions of how the varieties of superalgebras are defined and how they are related to the varieties of algebras.
